```yaml
name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run tests
        run: bun run test
```
